test_title: PYST 47: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The homework must be done by you.

options.text: You should have done the homework.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "You must do the homework."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the homework" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "must do" to "must be done" (modal verb passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "you".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"You must do the homework."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"You should have done the homework." – Incorrect modal verb (should have done) does not match "must be done".
 
• **Option 2: **"You do the homework." – Incorrect in conveying the necessity implied by "must".
 
• **Option 3: **"You will do the homework." – Incorrect future tense, does not match the modal verb "must".
